newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. chief recommends Golan Heights force renewal.
newsitem.headline: U.N. chief recommends Golan Heights force renewal.

text.p: Secretary-General Kofi Annan on Tuesday recommended a six-month renewal, until Nov. 30, of the U.N. Disengagement Observer Force (UNDOF) serving as a buffer between the Syrian and Israeli armies on the Golan Heights.
The 1,050-member force has been deployed since 1974 to monitor a ceasefire and troop withdrawal that followed the 1973 Middle East war.
It comprises troops from Austria, Canada, Japan and Poland and is commanded by Major-General Johannes Kosters of the Netherlands.

Annan also said in a written report to the Security Council that unpaid assessments for UNDOF owed by U.N. members totalled about $48.2 million -- well over the force's current annual budget of some $32.3 million.
